extracted.name: Low Carb (Keto-friendly) Lavash Lasagna
extracted.description: Low Carb Lasagna fast and easy ingredients available on your favorite market. I added the brands use on my recipe for macros purposes. Per serving 4.1g Net Carb 17g Protein 14.9g Fat 225 Calories
ingredient_lines: 3 Slice @josephspitabread Flax, Oat Bran & Whole Wheat Lavash Bread for layers
1/2 cup Nancy’s Organic cultured Low fat cottage cheese
100 g Cabot Vermont Cheddar Cheese Seriously Sharp
2 package Sazón Goya Culantro y Achiote
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Place the pork ground meat into a skillet over medium heat, add the garlic powder, Adobo Goya, Recaito & Sazon Goya to the skillet. Cook the meat, chopping it into small chunks as it cooks, until no longer pink, and cook about 10 minutes. Drain excess grease. Then added the marinara sauce cook other 5 minutes.

Place 1 Joseph Pita Breas Lavash into the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking pan; top with a layer of the Ricotta Cheese & cottage cheese mixture an a layer of pork ground meat mixture, mozzarella and cheddar cheese. Second layers of another slice of Joseph Pita Bread Lavash top with a layer of mozzarella cheese, cheddar cheese and pork ground meat mixture and ending with a Third layer Joseph Pita Bread Lavash top with the mozzarella cheese and Cheddar cheese. Cover the dish with aluminum foil.
